title: aisync demo: two AI tools reach for the same file

steps.cmd: aisync claim -a claude-code -p checkout-api -f app/api/refunds.py -m "add refund reasons"
aisync claim -a codex -p checkout-api -f app/api/refunds.py -m "rename refund fields"
aisync log -a codex -p checkout-api -k blocked -m "waiting for claude-code: app/api/refunds.py"
aisync claim -a codex -p checkout-api -f app/api/refunds.py -m "rename refund fields"
